description: Send native COOK (omit `mint` or use the COOK mint) or an SPL/Token-2022 token to another wallet, creating the recipient's token account if needed. An optional `memo` is written to the transaction through the SPL Memo program, signed by this wallet — pass it when paying an invoice or payment request whose app matches transfers by memo. Simulates before sending. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY.

memo.description: text recorded on-chain with the transfer via the SPL Memo program (UTF-8, up to 566 bytes), e.g. an invoice reference; omit for a plain transfer

mint.description: token mint to send; omit for native COOK

name: transfer
title: Transfer COOK or a token
